name: Adzviser Salesforce
description:
Connect your Salesforce CRM data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files — Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about leads, opportunities, and pipeline. Compare owners and stages, dig into win rates and deal velocity, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Salesforce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Salesforce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://salesforce.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Salesforce MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Salesforce provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_salesforce, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Salesforce?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Salesforce in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Salesforce MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Salesforce requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Salesforce is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
